{{italic title}}
'''''OpenIntro Statistics''''' is an open-source textbook for introductory [[statistics]], written by David Diez, Christopher Barr, and [[Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel]].<ref>{{cite journal|last=Aphalo|first=Pedro José|date=February 2017|doi=10.19232/uv4pb.2016.2.90|journal=UV4Plants Bulletin|pages=51–53|title=Review of ''OpenIntro Statistics''|volume=2|issue=2 }}</ref>

The textbook is available online as a free PDF, as [[LaTeX]] source and as a royalty-free paperback.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.openintro.org/stat/textbook.php|title=OpenIntro|website=www.openintro.org|language=en|access-date=2017-12-31}}</ref>
